items.question: What alternative frequencies of recitation at night are permitted for this ritual practice?
premises: Recitation is prescribed as the ritual action.
The recitation may be performed three times as one option.
Alternatively, the recitation may be performed one time in the same manner at night.
items.inference: The ritual allows recitation either three times or once, performed likewise at night.
items.plain_english: One should recite three times, or alternatively one time, likewise at night.
